StatusDesc: Hold {0} and drag to open the ping wheel · {1} to toggle
TriggerKeyDesc: Hold this key and drag with the left mouse button to open the wheel
DragDistanceDesc: How far the mouse must move before the wheel opens
ClickToPing: Trigger key + click places a ping
ClickToPingDesc: Places the ping in the wheel's center. When off, trigger key + click goes straight to the app underneath
PauseFullscreenDesc: Full-screen games keep every click: trigger key + click is passed through to the game. Browsers (YouTube, Netflix…), video players and slideshows aren't affected.
ToggleHotkeyDesc: Works everywhere, even while pings are off
StartEnabled: Turn pings on when the app starts
StartEnabledDesc: When off, the app starts paused until you turn it back on
StartWithWindowsDesc: Run quietly in the system tray every time you sign in
PingSizeDesc: Size of the icons and emotes drawn on screen
TestPingDesc: Places the wheel's center ping at the cursor
EditSignalDesc:
Drag a ping onto a slot to place it there. Drop it in the center to make it the {0} + click ping.
Right-click a slot to assign an app or a shortcut. Drag a slot onto another to swap them, or back to the list to clear it.
EditEmoteDesc:
Drag an emote, image or sound onto a slot of the emote wheel. Drop it in the center to use it with {1} + click.
Right-click a sound in the library to rename it, add an image, set its volume or delete it. Right-click a slot to assign an app or a shortcut.
PaletteDesc: Click to preview. Drag onto the wheel to assign, or click an item and then a slot.
AssignHotkeyDesc: Press the key combination to send when you pick this slot. Esc to cancel.
EmoteKeyDesc: Hold this key and drag to open the emote wheel. Must differ from the trigger key.
ClickToEmote: Emote key + click places an emote
ClickToEmoteDesc: Off by default because Ctrl + click is commonly used for multi-select in other apps
EmoteSoundsDesc: Play each emote's sound at the volume set in Pings & sound
AddImageHint: PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP, up to 8 MB and 8192 px on the longest side. You can also drop images onto the list. Right-click an image to remove it. GIFs show their first frame.
ErrImageLimit: You've reached the limit of {0} images.
ErrImageFormat: {0}: only PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP are supported.
PlayerNameDesc: Shown under your pings on other people's screens
DataFolderDesc: Settings, your images and the error log are stored here
AboutDesc: Version {0} · Original icons and synthesized sounds
ErrHook: Couldn't install the mouse hook, so the wheel won't work. Try restarting lolPing.
ErrHotkeyInUse: The shortcut {0} is already used by another app. Please pick a different one.
SoundFolderNone: No folder chosen — using the built-in synthesized sounds. File names like Caution_ping_SFX.ogg or danger.wav are matched to pings automatically.
SoundFolderLoaded: {0} — {1} sounds loaded. Pings without a file keep the built-in sound.
IconFolderNone: No folder chosen — using the built-in icons. File names like caution.webp, on-my-way.png or e_laugh.png are matched automatically.
IconFolderLoaded: {0} — {1} icons loaded. Items without an image keep the built-in icon.
AddSoundHint: MP3, OGG, WAV, M4A, WMA, AAC or FLAC, up to 20 MB, plays up to 30 seconds. Pick several files or drop them onto the list. Sounds are copied into the library, so you can delete the originals.
ClipsOverlapDesc: When off, a new sound stops the one that's playing so spamming stays tolerable
StopSoundsHotkeyDesc: Instantly stops everything that's playing, including long library sounds
PickIconDesc: Choose the picture for "{0}". It's shown on the wheel and on screen; picking it plays your sound.
FullscreenAllow: Apps that still ping in full screen
FullscreenAllowDesc: .exe names separated by commas (e.g. Telegram, Notion). Common browsers and video players are already allowed.
FullscreenAllowDescLast: Last paused in “{0}”. If that isn't a game, use the button to allow it.
RoomJoinDesc: Create a room and send the code to your friends (up to 8 people). Your pings, emotes and sounds show up on everyone's screen. Everything is end-to-end encrypted.
RoomJoinHint: Paste a room code or invite, e.g. PING-RRG7C-9JM5B
RoomShare: Share this code with your friends. Copy includes the server address.
ErrRoomCode: Invalid room code. Codes look like PING-XXXXX-XXXXX (no digits 0, 1 or letters I, O).
ServerUrlNone: No server yet: you can only connect with people on the same Wi-Fi/LAN. See the README to set up a free server.
ServerUrlDesc: Everyone in the room must use the same server. It only forwards encrypted data.
LanEnabledDesc: Finds people in your room on the same Wi-Fi, no server needed. Windows asks for firewall access the first time: choose Allow.
InternetEnabledDesc: Use the server above to play with people on other networks
RoomSoundsDesc: Their custom sounds are downloaded once and kept on your computer
AutoRejoin: Rejoin the room when the app starts
AutoRejoinDesc: Goes back to your last room when lolPing starts
